loss.authInEachOperation: {{format}} writes this auth in each operation
loss.authMovedDown: {{format}} moves this auth down to the first level
loss.connectionQueryOffDropped: {{format}} keeps the query in the url: parameters switched off do not leave
loss.connectionsInFirstCollection: {{format}} writes the connections with the first collection
loss.disabledVariablesDropped: {{format}} cannot switch a variable off: those switched off do not leave
loss.examplesDropped: {{format}} keeps no examples: the ones on this request do not leave
loss.folderVariablesUnresolved: {{format}} does not resolve the variables of a folder
loss.foldersFlattened: {{format}} flattens the folders below, which lose their doc
loss.headersCopied: {{format}} copies these headers to each request
loss.headersInEachOperation: {{format}} writes these headers in each operation
loss.headersMovedDown: {{format}} moves these headers down to the first level
loss.messageDetailsDropped: {{format}} keeps only the title of a message and what it sends: the rest does not leave
loss.messagesInConnectionOfName: {{format}} keeps this message in the connection of its name, or in the first one
loss.messagesNeedConnection: {{format}} keeps messages inside a connection, and none is written here
loss.noVariables: {{format}} has no place for these variables
loss.noWebsocketMessages: {{format}} keeps no messages in its WebSocket requests
loss.noWorkspaceNotes: {{format}} has no place for the notes of a workspace
loss.schemasDropped: {{format}} keeps no schemas: the ones on this request do not leave
loss.settingsDropped: {{format}} does not carry every setting of this request
loss.socketioOwnKind: {{format}} keeps Socket.IO in requests of its own kind
loss.tagsDropped: {{format}} has no tags: the ones on this request do not leave
